generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A READY delivery certificate becomes invalid whenever any material repository write occurs after its freeze; unchanged semantic target identifiers do not preserve certificate freshness.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Keep an older certificate after a later test, documentation or source commit because the work item and branch names are unchanged, and treat the later write as evidence-only.
generalized_learning.reusable_control: Maintain a monotonic post-write-refreeze latch: once material dirtiness or an auditor refreeze floor is observed, only a new material freeze plus direct result-only child can restore readiness.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Track material dirtiness after every freeze and forbid handoff-only recovery after any non-result path write or stricter independent-audit recovery floor.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Before returning readiness, re-read the terminal head, compare it with the published handoff, validate direct parent and result-only allowlist, and require refreeze if any material path exists after freeze.

transfer_cases.scenario: A test-only commit lands after a valid handoff; recovery must require a new material freeze.
A documentation-only commit lands after a valid handoff; recovery must require a new material freeze.

skill_changes.change: Current delivery skill version enforces the material_dirty_since_freeze latch and treats independent-audit recovery scope as a lower bound.
Current delivery skill version validates terminal head, direct material parent and result-only changed paths before allowing re-audit.
